name: Wintonotitan
isnote: Hocknull et al. (2009) found it to be a non-titanosaurian titanosauriform and several later analyses agree (cited Wikipedia revision); the atlas has no clade for Titanosauriformes, so Macronaria is used.
sum: Wintonotitan is a titanosauriform sauropod from the Cenomanian Winton Formation of Queensland, Australia, known from partial postcranial remains.
wsnote: No length estimate was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: QMF 7292, partial postcranial remains first found in 1974 and originally assigned to Austrosaurus.
material: A second specimen, QMF 10916, of isolated tail vertebrae.
biology: No biological data were read in the sources consulted.
author: Hocknull et al. 2009
